title: Per-queue job settings: priority, retries, backoff, timeouts, dead letters
why: Background jobs get retries with backoff, long timeouts with lease renewal and inspectable dead letters, and queues no longer serialize each other.
changelog: Job enqueue takes a per-queue transaction lock
